task: multi-label pathway engagement: per-pathway probability that a peptide engages the pathway
architecture: per pathway, a 100-model PU (positive-unlabeled) bagging ensemble of RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, max_depth=5); each bag trains on all known positives plus an equal-sized random sample of the unlabeled set; probability = mean predict_proba over bags
feature_source: modlAMP GlobalDescriptor; Hydrophobicity/HydrophobicMoment from the Eisenberg scale
